creates_law_reviewed.class: ACCOUNTING CORRECTION / INPUT-LEDGER AUDIT -- it re-types one line of an existing input ledger and follows the consequence; it establishes no new proposition about the object.
creates_law_reviewed.basis: The positive content is that the SU(3)_2 readout is a function of m mod 15 while the manifold is not (verified exactly), that five independent selection principles all output m = 1, and that branch A's residues are the ones already disqualified elsewhere. The selection principles are all cited or previously banked; the volume and systole monotonicities are computed here but are ordinary facts about the family. The verdict is an accounting one.

claim_one_line: BRANCH A'S WORD ANCHOR IS NOT MIS-SIZED, IT IS MIS-TYPED -- AND RE-PRICED AS WHAT IT ACTUALLY IS, THE LAST LICENSED ROW'S ONLY SURVIVING READING GOES FROM +1.19 BITS TO -13.70. B1349 addendum 5 prices the word anchor as a LABEL: log2(7) = 2.81 bits to name a non-unit residue of Z/15, after which branch A's one surviving reading (4 values, ear discharged) closes by +1.19. B1404 put two outside theorems on the table that bear on that single line. LACKENBY 2003: the canonical Epstein-Penner decomposition of a once-punctured torus bundle IS the Floyd-Hatcher monodromy triangulation, so the word is not a label attached to a manifold, it is the manifold's own canonical decomposition read off. JORGENSEN + CALLAHAN: m004 is the UNIQUE orientable hyperbolic 3-manifold attaining J = 1, so m = 1 is the OUTPUT of a principle, not a choice from a menu. THE CRUX, VERIFIED EXACTLY: ord(R) = ord(L) = 15, so the SU(3)_2 readout is a function of m mod 15 -- weld(1) = weld(16) and weld(3) = weld(18) EXACTLY -- while the manifolds are not: vol(b++ R^1 L^1) = 2.0298832128 (identified as m004) against vol(b++ R^16 L^16) = 7.1768908459, a whole volume apart. SAME READING, DIFFERENT MANIFOLDS. So naming a residue and naming a manifold are DIFFERENT ACTS, and every selection principle the programme has is about the manifold. That is E72's class one level up: not one symbol carrying two values, but ONE ANCHOR PRICING TWO DIFFERENT CHOICES. FIVE PRINCIPLES, ALL LANDING ON m = 1, ALL ON THE DEAD BRANCH: minimal volume in the family (verified here, strictly increasing over m = 1..10); minimal systole 2 log lambda_m (verified, lambda_m strictly increasing); Jorgensen extremality J = 1 (B1345/B1401, Callahan's uniqueness cited); the McKay-unique shadow (B997, cited); the existence of a cusp-order conductor, m in {1,2} (B675/B1403). EVERY ONE OUTPUTS A UNIT OF Z/15, hence branch B. Not one principle in the corpus selects a branch-A word. AND BRANCH A'S OWN RESIDUES ARE THE ONES THE CORPUS ALREADY DISQUALIFIED: branch A = {0,3,5,6,9,10,12}, where 0 is the EMPTY WORD (R^0 L^0 = I, so weld = C and lambda = 1, ear-independent for a trivial reason, reachable by the real manifold m = 15 whose reading is nevertheless the bare charge conjugation); 3 is the BRONZE, B675's certified DEAF object (cusp shape's Galois group S_4, non-abelian, [Q(tau):Q] = 8, heard by no stage family at any rank); and 5, 6, 9, 10, 12 all have non-quadratic cusp fields (B1403). Branch A's cheapest live entry point is the one member of the family the corpus has PROVED no stage can hear. THE RE-PRICED LEDGER. If m = 1 is the output of a principle it costs 0 bits -- you name a condition, not a manifold. Abandon the principle and a manifold must be named explicitly, with a floor of log2|OrientableCuspedCensus| = log2(212641) = 17.70 bits, itself only a floor since Callahan's uniqueness is over ALL orientable hyperbolic 3-manifolds. Branch A's surviving reading: as banked (name a non-unit residue) 4 - 2.81 = +1.19, closes; with the degenerate residue 0 excluded, 4 - 2.58 = +1.42, closes by MORE -- reported because it cuts against this arc; naming the manifold with the principle forfeited, 4 - 17.70 = -13.70, FAILS. THE VERDICT IS A FORK AND BOTH HORNS FAIL THE ROW'S PURPOSE. If the row is a claim about THE OBJECT -- the only reading under which it can serve as 'the object predicts X' -- then the word must be the object's own, Lackenby says that word is not a free label, five principles say it is m = 1, and gcd(1,15) = 1 puts it on branch B, dead on two independent gates: THE ROW IS DEAD. If instead the row is a claim about a RESIDUE CLASS in SU(3)_2 modular data, branch A closes at +1.19 exactly as banked, BUT THE ROW IS THEN NOT ABOUT m004 and cannot be cited as the object predicting anything -- the class m = 3 contains no manifold any principle selects and its smallest member is deaf. Either way the row cannot do the job it was licensed for. THIRD INDEPENDENT GROUND for 'do not spend it', after addendum 1's arithmetic and addenda 2-4's kind. WHAT THIS DOES TO L209 (is the theta-even mirror row the right observable?): it does not make the owner's decision, it makes it DECIDABLE -- the question is no longer 'is this the right observable' in the abstract but 'is the row about the object or about a residue?', and both answers are now priced. FENCES: B1349's mathematics is UNTOUCHED -- the gcd(m,15) law, the exact spectra, the field statement, the C6 containment, the 4/4 split and the +1.19 of its own accounting all stand as computed; only the TYPE of the word anchor is in question. The 17.70 bits is a floor under one reading of the accounting and the census is a modelling choice, stated rather than hidden; the load-bearing claim is the TYPE argument, and the bit figure quantifies it rather than carrying it -- 2.81 against a departure from a five-fold selection is a mismatch of kind, not of magnitude. Jorgensen/Callahan, B997, B675's bronze deafness and Lackenby's canonicity are CITED, not re-derived. Nothing reaches CLAIMS.md, F2 or Gate 5; no value is compared to any measurement.
